prompt.title: Hello World Bash
prompt.goal:
Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_START the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS
Print "Hello World" in the console using a echo command

output-format-list.output-format-item: Not explain anything and show any output

Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_END the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Calculate in seconds the difference between PROMPT_EXECUTION_START and PROMPT_EXECUTION_END and store it in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME add a suffix " seconds" to the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME
Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with: a JSON object with the following fields:
{ "prompt-execution-ts-start": PROMPT_EXECUTION_START, "prompt-execution-ts-end": PROMPT_EXECUTION_END, "prompt-execution-duration": PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME }
Do for all commands.
<result>RESULT</result>

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The output is in the correct format
Print the XML result fragment with the final result of RESULT
